pricingComputed.flowCountNote: 22 is the number of flows we can individually name from the briefing + Celigo SIA domain knowledge (17 named + 5 placeholders for the uncharacterized custom integrations). The briefing states ~23 — the 23rd flow will be identified when the Celigo spreadsheet arrives. We price what we can name. Adjacent flows (UC14–UC18) are presented separately in the proposal as expansion scope, not included in the base price.
pricingComputed.kickoffRetainerNote: 11+ flows tier. Credited against first 6-month payment at go-live.
pricingComputed.implementationOnlyPaymentSchedule: 50% at SOW signing ($38,500) · 50% at UAT sign-off ($38,500)
pricingComputed.recommendedModelRationale: Homage currently relies on Sikich to manage their Celigo integration layer — they are not self-maintaining. IaaS replaces that Sikich/Celigo dependency with DataSkate ownership: same operational model, better platform. Their in-house engineers are AWS/Laravel infrastructure, not MuleSoft. Implementation Only is appropriate only if they plan to hire a dedicated MuleSoft developer post-go-live — flag this question in the proposal.
pricingComputed.psych_note: Operational-pragmatist buyer: IaaS frames as a single operational cost line replacing the Sikich/Celigo cost — no upfront, $X/month, done. Do not lead with 2-year totals; lead with the 6-month payment as the comparable to their current integration overhead.
pricingComputed.adjacentFlowsNote: UC14–UC18 (ShipStation tracking writeback, Loop Returns reconciliation, Orderful EDI splits) are presented in the proposal as identified expansion scope — not included in base pricing. Each has a clear promotion gate. Present as: 'We have identified 5 additional flows adjacent to your stated scope. These are not priced in this proposal but are ready to scope once you confirm interest.'
pricingComputed.proposalCaveat: PROPOSAL LANGUAGE — include verbatim in pricing section: 'Pricing above covers the 22 flows we have identified from your briefing. One flow from your stated scope of ~23 remains uncharacterized — once we receive the Celigo flow inventory spreadsheet, we will confirm the full list and issue a revised proposal with final flow count and locked pricing before any SOW is signed. The spreadsheet review typically takes 2–3 business days.'
